title: Analytical Visualization
description: Encodings, honest axes, and charts that carry a sentence.

levels.name: Foundation
levels.description: Can produce a chart whose title is a sentence, label axes with units, and name the geometry — bar, line or scatter — under written guidance.

levels.name: Apprentice
levels.description: Can replace a misleading chart and explain why it misled, use color for a meaning not decoration, and justify bar versus line versus scatter for the grain.

levels.name: Practitioner
levels.description: Can independently encode a claim so a stranger can read the sentence from the chart, keep filters visible, and refuse a dual axis or truncated scale that changes the claim.

levels.name: Journeyman
levels.description: Can diagnose a chart whose ink does not match the caption, cite the axis or encoding that lies, and produce a before/after pair another reviewer can judge.

levels.name: Mastery Evidence
levels.description: Can review another apprentice's figure, name an honest-axis violation or a decorative color, and teach when a table is more honest than a chart on an unfamiliar dataset.
